import asyncio
import logging
from contextlib import AsyncExitStack
from typing import Any
from fastmcp import Server
from mcp.client.session import ClientSession
from mcp.client.stdio import StdioClientOptions, stdio_client

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

async def run_proxy(backend_command: list[str]):
    """Run a FastMCP proxy server that forwards requests to a backend server."""
    proxy = Server("mcp-proxy")
    
    options = StdioClientOptions(
        command=backend_command[0],
        args=backend_command[1:],
    )
    
    async with AsyncExitStack() as stack:
        # Connect to backend
        read, write = await stack.enter_async_context(stdio_client(options))
        session = await stack.enter_async_context(ClientSession(read, write))
        
        # Discover and proxy all tools
        tools_response = await session.list_tools()
        for tool in tools_response.tools:
            async def tool_handler(tool_name=tool.name, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
                result = await session.call_tool(tool_name, kwargs)
                return str(result)
            
            proxy.add_tool(
                name=tool.name,
                description=tool.description or "",
                inputSchema=tool.inputSchema or {},
            )(tool_handler)
            logger.info(f"Proxying tool: {tool.name}")
        
        # Discover and proxy all resources
        resources_response = await session.list_resources()
        for resource in resources_response.resources:
            async def resource_handler(resource_uri=resource.uri) -> str:
                result = await session.read_resource(resource_uri)
                texts = [c.text for c in result.contents if hasattr(c, 'text')]
                return "\n".join(texts)
            
            proxy.add_resource(
                uri=resource.uri,
                name=resource.name,
                description=resource.description or "",
            )(resource_handler)
            logger.info(f"Proxying resource: {resource.uri}")
        
        # Run the proxy server
        await proxy.run_stdio()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    backend_command = ["python", "-m", "your_backend_module"]
    asyncio.run(run_proxy(backend_command))
